name: polish-paper
description: Advisor-guided review of a student's paper draft. Checks the argument, sections, paragraphs, figures, and length against an advisor's paper-writing guide, and proposes small revisions with reasons on an editing page, where the author accepts, rejects, or edits each one before it reaches the source. Can also write a mock reviewer report.

interface.shortDescription: Advisor-guided review of a student's paper draft
interface.longDescription: Advisor-guided review of a student's paper draft. Checks the argument, sections, paragraphs, figures, and length against an advisor's paper-writing guide, and proposes small revisions with reasons on an editing page, where the author accepts, rejects, or edits each one before it reaches the source. Can also write a mock reviewer report. It needs the writing-style-portable, html-templates and review-paper plugins from the same marketplace.
defaultPrompt: Use $polish-paper to review this draft with the advisor guide, proposing small revisions with reasons on the editing page for me to accept, reject, or edit.
